# PaperEdits Gemini Agentic Video Understanding Benchmark

> Public evidence package for an exploratory comparison of Gemini 3.7 Flash agentic and static video-understanding modes across six synthetic ten-minute fixtures.

PaperEdits maintains this benchmark and conducted the evaluation independently. It is not sponsored or endorsed by Google. Five fixtures produced valid pairs; the sample is too small to establish statistical significance or general model superiority. Use the frozen evidence and limitation-first analyses rather than treating headline metrics as a winner claim.

The clean-clone verifier costs $0, makes no model API calls, and uploads no media. External adoption remains zero until an independently authored reproduction, review, result card, or contribution is publicly accepted under the governance rules.

This file follows the llms.txt v2 proposal to help agents navigate public project evidence. It is not a Google Search ranking signal; Google states that its Search and generative-search systems ignore llms.txt.

## Start here

- [Repository README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sarvob/gemini-agentic-video-benchmark/main/README.md): Scope, result summary, $0 verification command, repository map, and contribution path.
- [Full benchmark report](https://paperedits.com/benchmarking/gemini-agentic-video-understanding-benchmark): Narrative methodology, findings, limitations, and product affiliation.
- [Frozen protocol v0.4](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sarvob/gemini-agentic-video-benchmark/main/benchmark/protocol-v0.4.md): Active evaluation protocol and exclusion rules.
- [Canonical aggregate](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sarvob/gemini-agentic-video-benchmark/main/benchmark/final-results.json): Machine-readable results for the five valid paired fixtures.
- [Paired uncertainty analysis](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sarvob/gemini-agentic-video-benchmark/main/benchmark/uncertainty-v0.4.md): Deterministic bootstrap intervals and exact sign-flip diagnostics.
- [Publication package](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sarvob/gemini-agentic-video-benchmark/main/benchmark/publication-package-v0.4.md): Release contents, claims that are supported, and claims that are not supported.

## Reproduce or contribute

- [Contributing guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sarvob/gemini-agentic-video-benchmark/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): $0 reproductions, annotation audits, rights-clear fixture proposals, and independent extensions.
- [Governance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sarvob/gemini-agentic-video-benchmark/main/GOVERNANCE.md): Acceptance rules, conflicts, public decision records, and external-reviewer path.
- [Result-card instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sarvob/gemini-agentic-video-benchmark/main/benchmark/result-card-v0.1.md): Versioned contract for comparable public results with immutable evidence.
- [Community results index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sarvob/gemini-agentic-video-benchmark/main/benchmark/community-results-v0.1.json): One maintainer reference and the explicit external accepted-result count.
- [Community reviewer registry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sarvob/gemini-agentic-video-benchmark/main/benchmark/community-reviewers-v0.1.json): Evidence-backed external review and contribution counts.
- [Independent reproduction form](https://github.com/sarvob/gemini-agentic-video-benchmark/issues/new?template=benchmark-reproduction.yml): Public reporting path; a GitHub username is sufficient and no full name or email should be posted.

## Focused analyses

- [Output-contract failure](https://sarvob.github.io/gemini-agentic-video-benchmark/output-contract-failure.html): Why one provider-completed agentic response was excluded.
- [Temporal miss analysis](https://sarvob.github.io/gemini-agentic-video-benchmark/temporal-miss-analysis.html): Short-event recovery, broad retrieval, and boundary limitations.
- [Quality and cost tradeoff](https://sarvob.github.io/gemini-agentic-video-benchmark/quality-cost-tradeoff.html): Reconciled quality, tokens, latency, paid-equivalent cost, and attrition.
